onboarding.title: Disclaimer
onboarding.subtitle: Please read and acknowledge the following risk disclosure and disclaimer before your first sign-in.

terms.p1:
1. Nature and acceptance of this notice
This notice sets out the risk disclosure and disclaimer you should read and acknowledge before accessing or using FX42 (the “Platform”). You should read it in full before your first sign-in. By checking the acceptance box and continuing to use the Platform, you confirm that you have read, understood and agree to this notice. If you do not agree with any part of it, please stop using the Platform.
terms.p2:
2. Nature of the service
The Platform provides a virtual foreign-exchange interface, market data, order processing and account records over DN42. Trades are executed with the Platform as counterparty and are not routed to a centralised public exchange; there is no guarantee that a counterparty will be available for any instrument at any time. The Platform may adjust instruments, leverage, margin requirements, fees, limits and trading hours for risk-management, liquidity, technical or compliance reasons.
terms.p3:
3. Eligibility, identity and account security
You must have full legal capacity and must ensure that your access to and use of the Platform comply with the laws and regulations applicable to you and with DN42 rules. You are responsible for safeguarding your OIDC identity, tokens, devices, keys and account credentials, and must not lend, transfer or permit unauthorised use of your account. Instructions issued through your identity or credentials are treated as yours unless the Platform is clearly at fault. You should promptly review your account, positions, balances and transaction records, and stop using the Platform and contact us if you notice anything unusual.
terms.p4:
4. Real accounts, simulated accounts and funds
Real accounts are denominated and settled in settlement assets supported by the Platform, including FTK. Simulated accounts use virtual funds (VFTK) solely for functional testing and risk demonstration. VFTK has no real monetary value, cannot be redeemed, transferred or withdrawn as real assets, and gives no right to any return or ownership interest. Deposits, withdrawals and settlements in real accounts may rely on third-party services; timing, availability and final results are subject to the actual processing of the Platform and those third parties.
terms.p5:
5. Leverage, margin and forced liquidation
Foreign-exchange and contract-for-difference trading involves high leverage and significant risk. A small adverse price movement can rapidly exhaust your margin. The Platform calculates risk from account equity, maintenance-margin ratios, risk limits and related parameters. If equity falls below the applicable requirement, the Platform may restrict new positions, raise margin requirements, reduce positions automatically or liquidate them without prior consent. Extreme markets, price gaps, insufficient liquidity or system delays can cause liquidation prices to differ materially from expectations and can result in losses exceeding your account balance. You are responsible for controlling position size, using stop-loss orders and bearing all trading outcomes.
terms.p6:
6. Market data, execution and slippage
Market data is obtained from third-party public market-data services and may be delayed, interrupted, erroneous, incomplete or inconsistent with prices actually available for execution. The Platform does not guarantee that quotes are real-time, accurate, complete or continuous. Market, stop-loss, take-profit and other conditional orders may fill at prices different from those expected, or may not fill at all, due to slippage, price gaps, insufficient liquidity, network latency, risk controls or changes in trading hours. The Platform may suspend quotes, restrict orders or cancel manifestly erroneous orders in response to abnormal markets, system failures or risk controls.
terms.p7:
7. Fees, financing and account adjustments
You must pay the trading fees, overnight holding fees, financing charges and other applicable fees published by the Platform. Rates, calculation methods, settlement periods and promotional arrangements may change and will take effect when published. The Platform may deduct fees due from your account balance; insufficient balances may trigger margin calls, position reductions or liquidation. You are responsible for losses and costs arising from incorrect account information you provide, failed third-party payments, refunds, chargebacks or disputes.
terms.p8:
8. Weekends, holidays and market events
Foreign-exchange markets may gap at the open and may experience wider spreads, sharply reduced liquidity or interrupted quotes during weekends, holidays and major events. The Platform may raise margin requirements, limit leverage, suspend new positions or reduce high-risk positions before weekends or market closures. You should maintain sufficient margin and assess overnight and weekend risk yourself. The Platform is not responsible for losses caused by market closures, price gaps or changes in liquidity.
terms.p9:
9. Third-party identity, payment and technology services
The Platform uses DN42 identity services, OIDC providers, third-party payment and settlement services, market-data services and infrastructure providers. The availability, accuracy, security and results of those services are not fully controlled by the Platform. Outages, delays, failures, policy changes or data errors at third-party services may affect sign-in, deposits, withdrawals, market data and trading. You must also comply with the terms of any third-party service you use. The Platform does not warrant third-party services but will provide reasonable assistance in investigating issues.
terms.p10:
10. Prohibited conduct
You must not use the Platform for money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, market manipulation, insider trading, unlawful arbitrage, regulatory evasion, infringement of the rights of others or any other unlawful activity. You must not attack, scan or interfere with the Platform’s systems, circumvent risk controls, limits, identity verification or access controls, or use automated programs, interfaces or vulnerabilities to obtain an improper advantage. The Platform may restrict, freeze, investigate or terminate accounts suspected of violations and may report them as required by law.
terms.p11:
11. Availability, changes and termination
The Platform may suspend, restrict or terminate all or part of the service for maintenance, upgrades, network failures, abnormal markets, risk controls, legal or regulatory requirements, and will give advance notice where reasonably possible. The Platform may add, change or discontinue features, instruments, rules and fees. The Platform may restrict or terminate your account if you breach this notice, if uncontrolled risk exposure exists or if the Platform reasonably considers it necessary. Termination does not affect rights and obligations already accrued, transaction records or dispute resolution.
terms.p12:
12. No investment advice
Market data, charts, indicators, notifications, examples, tutorials and other content displayed by the Platform are for information and functional demonstration only. They do not constitute investment, legal, tax, accounting or other professional advice, nor a recommendation, solicitation or guarantee of any transaction, strategy or result. You should make independent decisions based on your financial situation, experience, risk tolerance and applicable law, and consult a qualified professional where appropriate.
terms.p13:
13. Limitation of liability
To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, the Platform and its operators, contributors and service providers are not liable for indirect, incidental, special, punitive, lost-profit, loss-of-goodwill or opportunity losses arising from the use of or inability to use the Platform, reliance on market data or information, trade execution, third-party services, cyberattacks, data loss, equipment failure or other events beyond their control. The Platform’s aggregate liability for direct losses is limited to the service fees you actually paid to the Platform during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. Liability that cannot be limited or excluded by law is not affected by this section.
terms.p14:
14. Intellectual property, privacy and data
The Platform’s software, interface, graphics, marks, documentation and other content are protected by intellectual-property laws. You must not copy, modify, distribute, reverse-engineer or commercially exploit them without authorisation. The Platform processes account information, transaction records, device information, IP addresses and logs to the extent necessary to provide the service, verify identity, manage risk, conduct audits and maintain security, and takes reasonable measures to protect data. You should understand that the internet and distributed networks are not absolutely secure, and the Platform cannot guarantee that any information or system will never be compromised.
terms.p15:
15. Changes, severability and applicability
The Platform may update this notice to reflect changes in the service, markets or law. The latest version will be displayed on this page and will take effect when displayed. You should review it periodically; continued use of the Platform constitutes acceptance of the updated notice. If any provision is held invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions will continue in effect. Matters not covered by this notice are governed by other rules published by the Platform. If this notice conflicts with other Platform rules, its provisions on risk disclosure and limitation of liability will prevail, except where liability cannot lawfully be limited or excluded.
terms.p16:
16. Acknowledgement
You acknowledge that you have read and understood this notice in full, particularly the provisions on leverage, margin, forced liquidation, market-data delay, third-party services and limitation of liability; that you voluntarily accept all risks of using the Platform and trading; and that you have made an independent judgement based on your own circumstances and have had the opportunity to consult a qualified professional.
